announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, Manassas, Virginia, is awarded an $88,177,120 cost-plus-fixed-fee and cost-only modification to previously awarded contract (N0002425C6108) for systems engineering and integration on Navy submarines. Work will be performed in Manassas, Virginia (68%); Waterford, Connecticut (10%); Groton, Connecticut (10%); Middletown, Rhode Island (7%); and Newport, Rhode Island (5%), and is expected to be completed by December 2027. Fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation (RDT&E) $5,224,058 (40%); fiscal 2025 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) $4,000,000 (30%); fiscal 2026 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) $4,000,000 (30%) funding will be obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Honeywell International Inc., Plymouth, Minnesota, is awarded a $23,151,326 firm-fixed-price job order against previously issued basic ordering agreement (N0016423GGM75) for integrated circuit factory equipment for strategic radiation-hardened microelectronics and sustainment support. This job order does not include options. Work will be performed in Plymouth, Minnesota and is expected to be completed by January 2028. Fiscal 2025 Title III funds in the amount of $23,151,326 will be obligated at time of award. The BOA and resulting JO were awarded on a sole-source basis in accordance with 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(3)(A), to maintain a facility, producer, manufacturer, or other supplier available for furnishing property or services in case of a national emergency or to achieve industrial immobilization. Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Crane, Indiana is the contract activity (N0016427FG003).

announcements.text: Martin Brothers Construction,* Sacramento, California, was awarded a $26,711,770 firm-fixed-price contract for the construction of an Energy Resilience and Conservation Investment Program microgrid. Bids were solicited via the internet with seven received. Work will be performed in Mountain View, California, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 13, 2028. Fiscal 2027 military construction, Army funds in the amount of $26,711,770 were obligated at the time of the award. U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, San Francisco, California, is the contracting activity (W91238-27-C-A002).

announcements.text: Deutsche Post AG, Bonn, Germany, has been awarded a $25,942,406 firm-fixed-price contract for mail handling services. This contract provides for mail handling services. Work will be performed at Frankfurt International Airport, Germany, and is expected to be completed by Nov. 30, 2031. This contract was a competitive acquisition, and three offers were received. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance funds in the amount of $4,388,419 are being obligated at the time of award. The 764th Enterprise Sourcing Squadron, Ramstein Air Base, Germany, is the contracting activity (FA5641-27-C-0001).

announcements.text: Georgia Tech Applied Research Corp., Atlanta, Georgia, has been awarded a $14,893,202 modification (P00011) to previously awarded contract (FA8730-23-F-0045) for the Multifunctional Information Distribution System Joint Tactical Radio System Upgrade (MJU) Program. This modification provides for the delivery of MJU terminals for integration into E-767 aircraft. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $54,761,205 from $40,443,133. Work will be performed in Atlanta, Georgia, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2028. This contract involves foreign military sales (FMS) to Japan. FMS funds in the amount of $14,318,072 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Hanscom AFB, Massachusetts, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Hardwick Tactical Corp.,* Mayaguez, Puerto Rico, has been awarded a maximum $20,240,482 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for intermediate weather outer layer, flame resistant, sage and operational camouflage pattern jackets. This was a competitive acquisition with one response received. This is a five-year contract with no option periods. The ordering period end date is Nov. 11, 2031. Using military service is Air Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2032 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE1C1-27-D-0014).
